crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.”
You will not need to fight this battle. Set yourselves, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh with you, O Judah…
For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still.
For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be…
He took off their chariot wheels, and they drove them heavily; so that the Egyptians said, “Let’s flee from the face of…
For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of…
Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp…
A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

translations.web: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.
translations.bsb: Each Israelite took his position around the camp, and the entire Midianite army fled, crying out as they ran.
translations.kjv: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
translations.asv: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp; and all the host ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.
